supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Prominent extension visible beyond the outer corners of the eyes on both lateral planes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-toned (lower melanin) muzzle and chin regions against the dark-toned (higher melanin) cheek and periocular regions

other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetrical mouth posture with the oral commissure pulled towards the subject's right side
